gloss: to establish, to set up, to prepare

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {設|もう}けていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to establish, to set up, to create
definitions.explanation: To create or put in place a system, facility, rule, or opportunity. Often used for formal or institutional arrangements.
To make preparations, such as setting up a seat for someone or preparing an occasion. More formal than simple preparation words.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦ルール→ルール：00354_ruuru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{設|もう}けた。
⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{相談|そうだん}{窓口|まどぐち}→相談窓口：23532_soudanmadoguchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{設|もう}けた。
examples.english: The company set up a consultation desk.

examples.japanese: ⟦{制限|せいげん}{時間|じかん}→制限時間：30577_seigenjikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{設|もう}けない⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{長引|ながび}く→長引く：14473_nagabiku⟧。
examples.english: If you don't set a time limit, the meeting will drag on.

examples.japanese: ⟦{来客|らいきゃく}→来客：13061_raikyaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{席|せき}→席：02215_seki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{設|もう}けた。
examples.english: I prepared a seat for the guest.

examples.japanese: ⟦{話|はな}し{合|あ}い→話し合い：14176_hanashiai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{場|ば}→場：03699_ba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{設|もう}けましょう。
examples.english: Let's arrange an opportunity to talk.

examples.japanese: ⟦{歓迎会|かんげいかい}→歓迎会：15791_kangeikai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{席|せき}→席：02215_seki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{設|もう}けて、⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦メンバー→メンバー：00275_menbaa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}えた→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧。
examples.english: We arranged a welcome party and received the new members.

notes:
USAGE:
{設|もう}ける is an ichidan verb. It is used in formal and semi-formal contexts for creating systems, rules, or occasions. It is distinct from the homophone ⟦{儲|もう}ける→儲ける：20583_moukeru⟧ (to earn a profit), which uses a different kanji.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{規則|きそく}→規則：01382_kisoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{設|もう}ける: to establish rules
- ⟦{制限|せいげん}→制限：03375_seigen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{設|もう}ける: to set limits
- ⟦{機会|きかい}→機会：01302_kikai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{設|もう}ける: to create an opportunity
- ⟦{場|ば}→場：03699_ba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{設|もう}ける: to arrange a venue/occasion
- ⟦{窓口|まどぐち}→窓口：03154_madoguchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{設|もう}ける: to set up a service desk

WATCH OUT:
Do not confuse with ⟦{儲|もう}ける→儲ける：20583_moukeru⟧ (to profit, to make money). The kanji are different: {設|もう}ける uses {設|せつ} (establish), while ⟦{儲|もう}ける→儲ける：20583_moukeru⟧ uses {儲|もう} (profit).
